_help: Copy this file to banks/<class>-<subject>.json, update all course metadata, and add the file to banks/manifest.json.
schemaVersion must stay 2. courseId must be '<class>-<subjectId>' and must match class and subjectId.
language is 'bilingual' for Classes 9/10 and 'english' for Classes 11/12. times are positive minutes; basis is 'stated' or 'inferred'.
alp.chapters and alp.excludedChapters must reference chapter numbers that exist in chapters. Empty chapters/patterns are allowed for a course not authored yet.
MCQ options must contain exactly four {en, ur} objects. answer is 'A', 'B', 'C' or 'D'. Use questionUr/ur as empty strings when no Urdu text applies.
Question objects support alpExcluded: true. Long questions support source: 'bank' (default) or 'composed'.

Inline rich text supports ..., ..., ..., ...,
, and isotope shorthand ^{mass}_{atomic}Element (for example ^{14}_{6}C). These tags are parsed from a whitelist; arbitrary HTML is displayed as text.

Questions and individual MCQ options may include optional figure and figureAlt strings. Put PNG/SVG files in figures/ and reference the filename (for example 'logic-gate.svg'); no external URLs or nested folders. SVGs must be self-contained and under 2 MB, with no scripts or external resources.

Pattern legacy shape: {id,name,note,mcq:{chapter:count},mcqMark,short:[{ch:{chapter:count},attempt}],shortMark,long:[[chapter,...]],longAttempt,longMark}. For split-part long questions use longGroups instead: [{id,name,attempt,questions:[{id,parts:[{label,marks,chapterRule:{type:'fixed'|'either'|'any'|'different-from-a',chapters:[...optional]}}]}]}]. Each question in a group must have the same part labels/marks; all groups may have different marks and attempt counts. 'fixed' takes one chapter, 'either' chooses among chapters, 'any' chooses from active ALP chapters unless chapters are specified, and 'different-from-a' chooses a chapter other than part (a). Do not mix non-empty legacy long slots with longGroups. Optional totalMarks is validated against the computed course total.
exclusionRules use {chapter,name,pages,pattern,flags}. Run 'node tools/validate-banks.js' and 'npm test' after editing.

LaTeX supports $x^2$ or \(\frac{a}{b}\) for inline math and \[\int_0^1 f(x)\,dx\] or $$...$$ for display math. MathJax renders the preview and DOCX export (as embedded PNG); an internet connection is needed on first use. Unsafe HTML and resource macros such as \href, \input and \includegraphics are rejected.
subject: Subject name

alp.summary: Add the ALP summary or notification reference here.

mcq.question: Write the question here. Example: H<sub>2</sub>O and x<sup>2</sup>; isotope ^{14}_{6}C.
